gap_classification_note_zh: 本文件登记的缺口按「谁有权产生」分三类，分类只描述产生主体与产生环节，不评价本次投稿的受理结果，也不改变任何条目的 status 与 value。participant_deliverable：参赛者自身有权产出、本应在本投稿包内交付的内容，当前 0 条。organizer_supplied_input：由征集组织方或有权测绘、规划主体发布的基础资料，参赛者无权自行产生，当前 2 条；在其发布前，本包以标注为临时的 provisional 几何登记并写明限制。external_credential：依法或依授权才能产生、须由有权主体在实施启动后签发的外部凭证，参赛者无权自行产生，当前 12 条。三类不可互相替代，也不可互相抵扣。字段口径：required_for_formal_submission 是本台账自建字段，官方工具不读取，其含义限定为「该项是否为正式投稿所需」，不等于必须由参赛者产出，也不表示对征集方受理结果的判断；required_for_formal_submission_scope 记录该项在哪个环节成为必需项；held_by_gate 记录触发前由正文哪一道门扣住；producible_by_participant 记录参赛者是否有权自行产生该项；now_verifiable_here 只列举本包内已经存在、可按所给指针逐项核对的内容。
gap_classification_note_en: Gaps recorded in this ledger are grouped by who has the authority to produce them. The grouping describes the producing actor and the producing stage only; it does not evaluate the intake outcome of this submission and does not change the status or value of any entry. participant_deliverable: content the participant is entitled to produce and should deliver inside this package; currently 0 entries. organizer_supplied_input: base material published by the open-call organizer or by duly empowered surveying and planning actors, which the participant may not produce; currently 2 entries, for which this package registers provisional geometry labelled as temporary and states its limits until publication. external_credential: credentials that may only be produced by law or by authorization and must be issued by duly empowered actors after implementation starts, which the participant may not produce; currently 12 entries. The three classes may not substitute for or offset one another. Field definitions: required_for_formal_submission is a ledger-defined field that official tooling does not read; it records only whether the item is required for formal submission. It does not mean that the participant must produce the item, and it does not judge the organizer's intake outcome. required_for_formal_submission_scope records the stage at which the item becomes required. held_by_gate records which gate in the narrative holds the item before triggering. producible_by_participant records whether the participant is entitled to produce the item. now_verifiable_here lists only content that already exists in this package and can be checked item by item at the pointers given.
